name: Seed Search
author: Rasmus
description: Find the seed you want before the run starts. Both Standard Run (Character Select) and Custom Run screens get a Search Seed button for finding seeds by Neow offers & outcomes, Act 2/3 Ancient relics, First Shop inventory, Treasure Chest & reward relics, bosses, events, fights, single-path & total map counts, and Floor 1 rewards (with OR filter groups, bookmarks, and saved searches).
